title: fix(deep-research): report text renders thin on macOS
body:
Related: #197458

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: Deep Research report text in the side panel renders thin on macOS.

## User Impact

User impact: long-form Deep Research reports keep normal macOS text rendering and read crisper; the pane's controls, tabs, status and source list are unchanged.

## Why This Change Was Made

The app body uses antialiased font smoothing, which turns off macOS stem darkening for everything below it. The plugin's own report rule now uses `auto` smoothing, matching what #197458 does for chat message text. The body default stays as is, so pane chrome keeps its current look. Inline citation buttons inside the report prose inherit the report's smoothing.

## Evidence

Maintainer validation after test cleanup: Both retained browser scenarios passed. New font-value-only assertions were removed; production source remains byte-identical to the submitted patch. No new raster captures are claimed; screenshot retakes were waived for this batch.

- `ui/src/e2e/deep-research-plugin.e2e.test.ts` (real plugin bundle and stylesheet mounted in the Control UI side panel, report tab open) now checks the rendered report's computed `-webkit-font-smoothing` is `auto` while the pane stays `antialiased`.
  - Red with only the CSS change reverted: `toHaveCSS` on `.deep-research-report` failed with `Expected: "auto"`, `Received: "antialiased"`.
  - Green with the fix: 2/2 passed; the file runs in about 13 s of test time (26 s wall including build), unchanged by the two added assertions.
- `oxfmt --check`, stylelint on the changed stylesheet, `git diff --check`, `pnpm check:test-lines-ratchet`, `pnpm tsgo:test:ui`: passed.
- Local review: autoreview (codex, gpt-6.1-sol), branch mode, base `dfdad1a806c534fcb41053b0d36f1ef6fd371857`, head `e5cdd9c714e4d6ef6e234716f6d8d645c422a556`, max priority P2: scoped-clean, no actionable findings. The published head `d53e34dd2424b160c8eb25e7771c5686f4c5fb2f` adds only an empty publication-marker commit on top of the reviewed commit (same tree).
- Screenshots: not captured. The requester waived macOS screenshots for this set of font-smoothing PRs and will verify locally. The difference is only visible on macOS.

Reported by @vyctorbrzezowski.
